name: hugo-mod-mermaid-vendored
description: Declares the third-party libraries this module vendors under assets/libs/. Never installed at build time or at runtime: it exists so Dependabot tracks their versions and GitHub raises security alerts on the code we actually ship. See ../VENDORED.md.

mermaid-zenuml.min.js.note: That file with the leading use-strict prologue dropped and window.zenuml appended, which is why the checksum matches no upstream file. VENDORED.md spells out the two edits.
